display_name: LoRa W24 首尾 chirp 受扰恢复与 clean 联合训练
description: Matched scratch training against the frozen 40,000-step W24 DURA with spatially balanced distorted-packet half-update loss and a clean outer-chirp loss.
authorization: Active LoRa and WiSig restoration research goal authorizes isolated component diagnostics.

code.environment: N607 fixed 7615e8e4 training archive and fixed W24 inference archive Python
code.cwd: original W24 DURA training archive for fit; original W24 reader archive for source inference

data.version: Native W24 1 MHz original Full and native_residual_w24_v1
data.representation: 8 chirps, 384 complex center samples + 48 native edge samples
data.contract_ref: Archived native W24 source release, data/source contract
data.validation_ref: Same parent Full and Residual raw ordered-prediction panel

permissions.claim_scope: Start from scratch using 20000 fit and 500 source-raw held U records. No classifier weights, labels, target or simulated metadata during fit.

checkpoint.initialization: Same original architecture initialized from scratch with the original seed

sources.role: Fixed source-only W24 DURA actual complete 40,000 updates

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: fit-inputs.json and frozen check in w24_outer_objective_source.load_candidate
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: The prior run supplies archived code and the external frozen control only. Fit children do not load prior state.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed last update 40000. Source promotion requires both routes to beat archived matched all-half six-scene score and at least match same-panel direct clean correct counts; target acceptance retains the original 30000-packet thresholds.

execution.gpu_policy: One qualified GPU, prefer 6 or 3; eight CPU channel workers
execution.stop_rule: Stop downstream on source binding, invalid gradient, nonfinite outputs, archive parity or incomplete source frozen predictions.

rows.method: Same two-stage W24 DURA with spatially balanced disturbed half-update risk and clean outer-chirp identity
rows.seed_notes: Both arms reuse the archive source partition, receiver-sampling and perturbation generators. Source V panel seed is 2026112559; eval seed records frozen W24 E104.
rows.budget_ref: 40000 joint optimizer updates, batch 16, original two-stage schedule

notes: No input gating or gate calibration. Both candidate and archived control always run a real restoration forward.
Protocol features come from each current received IQ only; no simulator truth or fitted classifier participates in fitting.
